entities.summary: Sadaf Khadem is a female boxer from Iran. She held her first official fight on April 14, 2019, where she defeated Anne Chauvin from France. This fight meant she was the first Iranian woman to be part of an official boxing match. Sadaf Khadem was a athletes & competitors from Tehran (b. 1995-01-23, Tehran). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
